description: ERC-8283 descriptor index schema. The entry point of a shared multi-descriptor container, mapping ERC-8176 descriptorHash values to the ERC-7730 descriptor JSON file each one identifies. Versioned in lockstep with the ERC-7730 descriptor schema carrying the identical version tag — see ERC-8283 'Index file schemas and versioning'.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The schema this index conforms to, identified by a URI whose last path segment is this schema's file name. Its version is identical to the ERC-7730 descriptor schema version this index is paired with. A consumer MUST treat a file naming a version it does not implement as invalid.

entries.title: Descriptor entries
entries.description: Maps each descriptorHash to the absolute URI of the ERC-7730 descriptor JSON file it identifies.

additionalProperties.title: Descriptor URI
additionalProperties.description: An absolute URI using the identical scheme that was used to successfully fetch this index.json itself — see 'Index file schemas and versioning' in ERC-8283. Never a relative path.
